title: Board report should include the grantee organisation number

articles.subject: Board report should include the grantee organisation number
articles.body:
Hello Mia,

A small wish. The board report we generate before each meeting lists grantee names only. Our treasurer wants the organisation number next to each name so he can match against the ledger without looking each one up.

Not urgent, but it would save him an evening every quarter.

Kind regards,
Gustav

articles.subject: Re: Board report should include the grantee organisation number
articles.body:
Hi Gustav,

That is a template change and I can do it, but the report template is shared with two other customers so I need to add the column as optional rather than by default. I have asked our developers what that takes.

I will come back to you within two weeks.

Best,
Mia

articles.subject: Board report should include the grantee organisation number
articles.body: Reminder pushed to 16 Sep. Still waiting for an estimate on making report columns configurable. Low value on its own but it is the kind of small ask that makes Gustav feel heard.
